outcomes_added.question_summary: Find the three-digit integer \(abc\) whose base nine representation is \(bca_9\).
outcomes_added.observation: The model translated the problem into an equation equating the decimal value \(100a + 10b + c\) to the base nine interpretation \(81b + 9c + a\), then rearranged and searched for digit values to satisfy the linear Diophantine equation. It systematically tested values of \(a\) and \(b\) to find integer \(c\), arriving at the correct solution 227.
